reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that; there is no NSF or USP seal and no reviews, so I stay with my Pure Encapsulations or Thorne. The sachets are handy for travel, but that is not enough to switch from a brand I trust.
objection: A new brand with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the brand's own report is not the same as third-party certification, and I take this for my doctor's advice, so I will not gamble.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, or a good number of verified reviews from real buyers.
